components.purpose: Identify one presenter or collaborator beside slide content.
components.contentLimits: Name 32 characters; role or affiliation 48 characters.
components.accessibility: Use an informative avatar alt or mark it decorative when the adjacent name is present.

components.purpose: Attach a compact source marker to a claim.
components.contentLimits: One citation marker; source label 64 characters.
components.accessibility: Use a link with an accessible source label and visible focus.

components.purpose: Place one provenance line at the slide edge.
components.accessibility: Use a footer landmark and readable text, not color alone.

components.contentLimits: Two to four entries; 110 characters per entry.
components.accessibility: Use an ordered list with visible numbering.

components.purpose: Navigate and orient within a bounded deck sequence.
components.accessibility: Use accessible previous/next buttons and a live page tracker.

components.purpose: Name the current section without competing with the title.
components.accessibility: Use a visible heading-level label in reading order.

components.purpose: Show coarse progress through a sequence.
components.accessibility: Pair the bar with a text label and current step.

components.purpose: Frame one rounded-cropped figure with caption and credit; no visible outline.
components.accessibility: Require meaningful alt text and keep caption adjacent.

components.purpose: Arrange two to four related rounded-cropped images without visible outlines.
components.contentLimits: Two to four images; one short caption each.
components.accessibility: Give every image distinct alt text and preserve source order.

components.purpose: Emphasize one measured result with its unit.
components.accessibility: Read value, unit, and qualifier as one group.

components.purpose: Compare two named states on one criterion.
components.contentLimits: Two items; one criterion; 40 characters per label.
components.accessibility: Use headings and explicit values; do not rely on color.

components.contentLimits: Three to five steps; two lines per step.
components.accessibility: Use an ordered list and visible step names.

components.purpose: Group one topic of slide content on a bounded surface.
components.accessibility: The title is the accessible name; the rounded border is decorative.
